reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes a team opportunity for automated, passive forex trading involving Bitcoin and directs viewers to “Get Started Now.” The funnel says the trading page can generate more Bitcoin, requests contact details to view videos, and states that starting costs $100, framing the material as a financial participation solicitation. the available video evidence does not establish actual returns, payment completion, or resulting loss.

citations.quote: We have a funnel by the name of MyBullRun.com that you can use.
finally revealed new automated force trading system that anyone can use to generate more bitcoin
amount to start is one hundred dollars in the platform
when people put in their information their name email and mobile phone and click the watch videos

opening.argument: Judge the claim actually presented, not a guaranteed-return claim that is absent. The speaker describes a tool for building capture pages and follow-up campaigns, then invites viewers unfamiliar with the trading platform to examine its tour. The video does not promise a particular return or show that anyone funded an account. The phrase about generating more Bitcoin deserves scrutiny, but it does not, by itself, establish a guaranteed outcome or deceptive solicitation.

citations.quote: You can make your own video pages, you can do it yourself, lead capture pages, and you can have multiple different campaigns for different opportunities.
if you don't know anything about miri training international click the tour link check it out
finally revealed new automated force trading system that anyone can use to generate more bitcoin

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited funnel, contact form and $100 starting amount establish a route to learn about and potentially join the platform, not a completed deposit, a promised rate of return or a resulting loss. Even the prosecution acknowledges those outcomes are not established. The automated-trading phrase is promotional, but its wording does not guarantee how much Bitcoin anyone will receive.

citations.quote: when people put in their information their name email and mobile phone and click the watch videos
amount to start is one hundred dollars in the platform

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A fixed return or completed loss is not necessary to assess what this video promotes. The capture page says anyone can use an automated trading system to generate more Bitcoin, while the speaker gives a starting amount and asks viewers to join his team. The tour language does not turn that financial recruitment pitch into a risk warning; no warning is cited.

citations.quote: finally revealed new automated force trading system that anyone can use to generate more bitcoin
amount to start is one hundred dollars in the platform if you don't know anything about miri training international click the tour link check it out join my team and get started

opening.argument: The substance of this recording is an operational walkthrough. The speaker takes viewers into a back office and explains the fast-start training, system videos, page settings and email campaigns. He also traces what happens after someone enters contact details on his capture page. Those concrete steps make the video useful as a demonstration of a marketing workflow, regardless of whether the trading platform shown in that workflow merits separate scrutiny.

citations.quote: I'm going to take you in the back office and show you what's going on.
the system training is a list of videos that show you exactly how to do everything with in the system
view your emails messages, edit email messages, create email campaigns, add messages
when people put in their information their name email and mobile phone and click the watch videos i'ma show you exactly what happens next

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution's excerpts identify the trading offer encountered in the walkthrough, but they do not account for how much of the speaker's explanation concerns configuring pages, messages and training. Showing a capture page and explaining where it leads can be instruction about the funnel itself. The $100 figure describes the platform's entry point; it does not erase the demonstrative content.

citations.quote: the first thing you're going to want to do is do the fast start system training
amount to start is one hundred dollars in the platform

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The walkthrough teaches viewers how to deploy the promotional funnel, not merely how a neutral tool works. Its capture page pitches automated trading as a way to generate more Bitcoin. The speaker then states the platform's starting amount and explicitly asks viewers to join his team. Operational instruction and financial solicitation coexist here; the tutorial format does not negate the pitch.

citations.quote: finally revealed new automated force trading system that anyone can use to generate more bitcoin
amount to start is one hundred dollars in the platform if you don't know anything about miri training international click the tour link check it out join my team and get started

opening.argument: The clearest priced product the speaker explains is a $30-a-month marketing service with an autoresponder, prepared follow-up campaigns, capture pages and a monthly text-message allowance. He says the campaigns can serve other businesses too. That is an ordinary service with identifiable features, not evidence that this video itself collects deposits, requests trading credentials or pays recruitment commissions. The separate $100 platform starting amount calls for caution, but the record should not convert every referral to a trading platform into proof of those unshown mechanisms.

citations.quote: It's $30 a month and you get everything complete with auto responder. You get follow up campaigns already designed for you and you get, of course, the capture pages.
you can have multiple different campaigns for different opportunities. This is for all your other businesses.
Every month you get 250 uh text messages
amount to start is one hundred dollars in the platform

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution is right that the funnel collects contact information and links to a trading opportunity. But name, email and phone number are lead-capture details, not trading credentials or proof of payment. The speaker's stated $30 monthly price is for the funnel service; the cited $100 amount refers to a different platform. Conflating those two offers overstates what the walkthrough establishes.

citations.quote: when people put in their information their name email and mobile phone and click the watch videos
It's $30 a month and you get everything complete with auto responder.
amount to start is one hundred dollars in the platform

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The marketing service is real context, but the speaker uses it to promote participation in automated trading. The capture page claims the system can generate more Bitcoin, and the speaker gives a $100 starting amount before urging viewers to join his team. No completed deposit or recruitment commission need be shown to recognize the financial solicitation conveyed by the video.
